full_judgment: 2. The opposite party No. 2 as pre-emptor filed the pre-emption petition under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 before the Assistant Judge, Hathajari, Chittagong impleading the present petitioner as pre-emptee and others for getting the land by pre-emption. Present petitioner-opposite party No. 7 was subsequently impleaded as opposite party in the proceeding. The pre-emptors amended the application and sought a declaration that the right, title and interest whatever accrued by opposite party No. 7 be devolved upon the pre-emptor. The pre-emptee opposite party contested the case by filing written objection denying the claim of the pre-emptors. The petitioner opposite party No. 7 also entered appearance and filed written objection claiming that he purchased the case land vide deed of sale dated. 11-2-1988 and 9-2-1989 and got possession from the pre-emptee and also mutated his name in the record of right.
